ShortDescription.Value: Repairs broken company brand references on map load, with optional cleanup of orphaned props.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Company Brand Fix
Repairs broken or missing company brand references when a city finishes loading. Essentially, this cleans up broken brands attached to companies after brands are changed/deleted. If you unsubscribe from a company brand pack (whether it be made by me or someone else), this will ensure you won't have broken brands or broken props that show up as gridded boxes.
## Features
- Repairs companies whose brand reference is null, deleted, stale, or no longer resolves to a valid loaded prefab. - Uses the company's own compatible brand list when selecting a replacement. - Leaves valid company brands untouched. - Runs once after each map load and then becomes dormant. - Includes an optional **Delete broken props on startup** setting. - When enabled, the prop cleanup runs only after brand repair has completed. - Healthy props and buildings are not modified. - Broken standalone props are removed. - Broken building-owned props are removed and only the affected building is refreshed.
## Performance
The company repair and optional prop cleanup are one-time map-load passes. There is no continuous city-wide scanning after the repair completes.
## Safety
The mod validates prefab references before modifying them and avoids replacing buildings or guessing replacement props. If a reference cannot be repaired safely, it is skipped or removed according to the selected cleanup behavior.
